meta.association: Heterozygous CYFIP2 variants cause a neurodevelopmental spectrum, often through de novo missense changes. Arg87 substitutions tend toward severe DEE, while Asp724 and other substitutions are more variable. Specific late splice-altering, in-frame deletion and frameshift alleles are also reported.
